extracted.intended_audience: Researchers applying to The Donaghue Foundation (health services researchers; current and past Donaghue grantees for R3)
extracted.subtask_description: Program-level guidance for applicants to The Donaghue Foundation's 2026 grant opportunities, describing program goals, eligibility, allowable activities, funding limits, and data requirements for Another Look, Greater Value Portfolio, and R3 awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Another Look 2026 — target population and purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: Another Look 2026 provides funding for health related research projects that can improve the quality of care and the quality of life for adults who are 65 years or older.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should be focused on improving care quality and quality of life for older adults (65+).

rubrics_metrics.name: Another Look 2026 — data requirement (existing datasets; limited new data)
rubrics_metrics.description: This program requires researchers to rely on existing datasets to address the research question they seek to answer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Limited collection of new data is allowed in this program if it will enhance the utility of the project outcomes to improve quality across care settings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Greater Value Portfolio 2026 — funding amount and term
rubrics_metrics.description: The Donaghue Foundation will fund research projects for two years with a maximum amount of $500,000 per award (plus a 10% indirect cost rate).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should budget within the two-year period and the $500,000 cap and include a 10% indirect cost rate where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Greater Value Portfolio 2026 — purpose and expected product
rubrics_metrics.description: To advance promising approaches to achieve a higher-value healthcare system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The goal of this program is to test approaches and tools that organizations can readily use to improve the value of the healthcare they provide to patients and communities; projects should emphasize practical, adoptable solutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: R3 2026 — applicant eligibility (current and past Donaghue grantees only)
rubrics_metrics.description: The R3 program is only open to current and past Donaghue grantees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only applicants who have previously received (or currently hold) Donaghue funding are eligible to apply; contact r3@donaghue.org for additional information.

rubrics_metrics.name: R3 2026 — project focus: scaling, spread, and implementation (not new research)
rubrics_metrics.description: The goal of the R3 grant program is to help researchers better prepare their health interventions for adoption and use in real-world settings. The R3 grant program is not intended to fund new research. Research can be a small aspect of the overall project; however, projects must be largely focused on scaling, spread, and implementation of their health interventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should be primarily concentrated on activities that promote adoption, dissemination, scale-up, and sustainability (e.g., implementation planning, accessing experts in scale/spread). Proposals that propose primarily new research are out of scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: R3 2026 — interdisciplinary expertise and purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: In creating this program, we recognize that expertise from disciplines outside those traditionally eligible for research funding is needed for scaling, dissemination, and sustainability of evidence-based programs and practices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: R3 supports access to nontraditional expertise (e.g., implementation science, commercialization, operations, communications) by funding investigators to engage those experts to better position interventions for growth and sustainability after research completion.

rubrics_metrics.name: R3 2026 — application timing and contact
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications are accepted on a rolling basis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interested applicants (current and past grantees) should email r3@donaghue.org for additional information and can apply any time during the rolling submission period.
